Billionaire investor Ray Dalio joins Tucker Carlson to warn of America's hidden civil war and its race with China. Dalio, founder of Bridgewater, studies history in big cycles of rise and decline. His forecast here is sober, from a man who has called major turns before.

Dalio explains the signs he sees of internal conflict and weakening order in the United States. He compares America's position with China's in tech, economics, and universities. Carlson asks what citizens and investors should do with such a warning. Serious and investor-minded viewers get a big-cycle briefing on the country's road ahead.
